2608.25148.title: Can You Trust Frozen Hematology Foundation Models under Acquisition Shift?
2608.25148.paper_summary: Frozen hematology foundation-model (FM) embeddings reach near-saturated in-domain white-blood-cell (WBC) accuracy, but clinical deployment demands reliability across scanners, sites, stains and preparation pipelines. We audit 15 frozen encoders (hematology, pathology, and general vision) across four public single-cell acquisition domains along two axes: accuracy robustness and calibration. In-domain linear-probe macro-F1 is saturated (0.98-0.997), yet cross-dataset macro-F1 drops 34-72% and rankings re-order: DinoBloom-L, the in-domain best, falls to 10th of 15 on the most-shifted target (MLL23) at the benchmark's shared 224-px input, behind RedDino and several general and pathology encoders. Rank transfer is probe-dependent: 1-NN retrieval is more stable on average than a source-fitted linear head (median $ρ$ 0.65 vs 0.45), but neither probe universally predicts target robustness. Calibration also collapses: source-trained probes are nearly calibrated in-domain (expected calibration error, ECE, 0.004) but confidently wrong off-domain (ECE 0.35), and source-fitted temperature scaling transfers poorly. We further audit pretraining exposure and identify MLL23 as DinoBloom's internal cohort; because DinoBloom's only held-out dataset is also our source domain, this benchmark cannot isolate exposure from scanner-associated shift. Label-free adaptation and marginal-entropy-based model selection appear safe under balanced evaluation but fail under realistic WBC class-prior shift. Class-Balanced Re-standardization (CBR), a training-free pseudo-label-balanced feature normalization, improves all evaluated target-prior scenario means and partially improves calibration, although encoder-level exceptions and residual miscalibration remain. Hematology FM benchmarks must therefore jointly audit accuracy, calibration, exposure, and class-prior robustness.
2608.25148.paper_summary_zh: 冷凍血液學基礎模型 (FM) 嵌入在領域內的白血球 (WBC) 準確度幾乎達到飽和，但臨床部署要求在掃描儀、地點、染色和準備流程之間的可靠性。我們在四個公共單細胞獲取領域中，沿著準確性穩健性和校準兩個軸心，審核了 15 個冷凍編碼器（血液學、病理學和一般視覺）。領域內的線性探針宏 F1 值已達飽和（0.98-0.997），然而跨數據集的宏 F1 值下降了 34-72%，排名也重新排序：在基準共享的 224 像素輸入下，領域內最佳的 DinoBloom-L 在最具轉變的目標 (MLL23) 中下降至 15 個中的第 10 位，落後於 RedDino 和幾個一般及病理編碼器。排名轉移依賴於探針：1-NN 檢索的穩定性平均上比源適配的線性頭更高（中位數 $ρ$ 0.65 對 0.45），但無論哪種探針都無法普遍預測目標的穩健性。校準也崩潰：源訓練的探針在領域內幾乎已經校準（預期校準誤差，ECE，0.004），但在域外卻自信地錯誤（ECE 0.35），而源適配的溫度縮放轉移效果不佳。我們進一步審核預訓練的暴露情況，並確定 MLL23 為 DinoBloom 的內部隊列；因為 DinoBloom 唯一的保留數據集也是我們的源域，這個基準無法將暴露與掃描儀相關的轉變分開。無標籤適應和基於邊際熵的模型選擇在平衡評估下顯得安全，但在現實的 WBC 類別先驗轉變下失敗。類別平衡再標準化 (CBR)，一種無訓練的偽標籤平衡特徵正規化，改善了所有評估的目標先驗場景均值，並部分改善了校準，儘管編碼器級別的例外和殘餘的錯誤校準仍然存在。因此，血液學 FM 基準必須共同審核準確性、校準、暴露和類別先驗的穩健性。
2608.25148.author: Jai Kumar Sharma et.al.
